The '''V-59 Concussion grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]-sized [[sapper charge]]<ref name="Fire and Ice">{{ESBRadio|Fire and Ice}}</ref> often used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After rappelling up to and cutting through its belly armor with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used one of these to destroy ''[[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]]'' during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Concussion Grenade">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Concussion Grenade}}</ref>
